# 🧹 Deprecation Plan

## Component
File, function, script entry point or dependency being deprecated.

## Reason
Explain maintenance, correctness, compatibility or safety issue.

## User impact
Who uses it and what breaks?

## Replacement
Document the supported alternative and migration instructions.

## Timeline
Announcement, warning period and removal target.

## Compatibility
Aliases, redirects or temporary support required.

## Verification
Tests, docs, examples and deployment entry points updated.

## Rollback
Conditions and steps to restore the prior behavior.
